name: subagents
description: Delegate scoped, read-only code investigation to any OpenAI-compatible model, for a fixed small context cost

plugins.name: subagents
plugins.description: Run agentic, read-only subagents on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, LiteLLM). The delegate reads, greps, and globs files directly; the orchestrator gets back a small JSON envelope instead of the whole transcript. Editing and other write tools are planned, not shipped.
